career_history: Executive Vice President at T5 Data Centers, 6/2019 to 11/2024; Senior Vice President at T5 Data Centers, 12/2016 to 6/2019; Vice President - Development at T5 Data Centers, 12/2012 to 12/2016; Senior Project Manager at T5 Data Centers, 1/2012 to 12/2012; Senior Engineer at Holder Construction, 6/2007 to 12/2011; Field Construction / Maintenance Enginneer at Western Carolina University, 8/2006 to 6/2007; Football Player at Western Carolina University, 1/2005 to 1/2006; Player in Organization at Detroit Tigers, 6/2002 to 8/2004

biography:
As Executive Vice President, Robbie leads T5's Development team associated with "project delivery" for T5's data center portfolio across the world including design, construction, equipment and utility procurement, commissioning, security integration, and successful handoff to Facility Operational Mangement 

Prior to Robbie's dedicated Development focus, Robbie established T5's General Contractor business in 2014 becoming licensed in nearly every US state, and led this team for 10+ years growing the group to $300m of annual revenue.
 

Robbie holds a B.S. in Construction Management with a minor in Business Management from Western Carolina University.


For more information on T5CS and T5 Data Centers visit:

www.t5datacenters.com
